visual_action: A montage of scenes from the World Economic Forum in Davos and a "Board of Peace" summit, both dated 2026. The video opens with scenic shots of snowy mountains and a helicopter landing. It then shows Donald Trump speaking at both events, receiving applause, signing a document for the "Board of Peace," and being greeted by other world leaders. The video also includes brief shots of Marco Rubio, Karoline Leavitt, and Jared Kushner. The montage concludes with shots of international flags and a final slate with the White House logo.
